Specification: This module is a small propositional-logic test specification that checks the evaluation of Boolean formulas and basic Boolean set facts. It declares Boolean state variables x, y, and z plus an integer variable w, initializes them to fixed values, and defines an invariant Inv consisting of many IF-THEN-ELSE checks that call Assert on failure and Print on success. The Next action is a stuttering-style action that leaves all variables unchanged while containing TLC assertions intended to test propositional conditions, and the file does not define a temporal Spec or fairness condition.
